beats.text: This pull request adds API keys.
Three parts of the request path are new or changed.
First, the schema. There are two migrations.
The first creates a new table, API keys. It stores a hash of the key, and links back to users.
The second adds a limit column to users. It is not null, with a default of five.
Now follow one request. A client posts to the new route, and the controller hands it to the service.
The service first reads the limit for that user.
Then it inserts the new key, storing only the hash.
One thing to check. The read and the insert are separate steps, so two requests at once can both get past the limit.
